XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Component: Throttle body

  • Fault: The vehicle occasionally fails to start or stalls unexpectedly. At the same time, erratic running is observed, with a low idle speed. Once started and moving, the engine runs smoothly.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: - -

  • Cause: Fouled throttle body

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the throttle body; clean it if necessary

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: In this case, the throttle body was cleaned to permanently resolve the fault.
    The component is located between the engine and the passenger compartment, on the driver’s side, at the top of the engine.
